notes.title: Free roam mode and new achievements
notes.content:
Hello, fellas!

I added 7 new achievements (5 from XBox 2nd update and 2 brand new ones).

And a long awaited "Free Roam Mode". You can pause/unpause the story any time on the "pause screen". To activate it you need to finish the story and see the credits roll. After you get the achievement and run the game from Steam - you'll see the option.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32626098/3845c113f1885223e1f945b99726b9e1fdf2f575.png

You also can turn the music off now (on the same screen). Maybe I'll add a couple more achievements next week, but overall I'm happy with the update so that's it.

Enjoy!

* Please report bugs at the forum so I can fix them.

notes.title: EX update is live now!
notes.content:
Hello!

EX update is live now. What's inside:

[previewyoutube=ZPw7cEZ7Tx8;full][/previewyoutube]

1. Local 2 player coop
2. Updated sprites for characters
3. Bicycles
4. New street with a bicycle store and a fish store
5. New skills for Mechanic "dojo", new throw (suplex from FA), brand new karate drop kick
6. Updated battle mechanics
7. KO animations from FA
8. Skippable cutscenes and dialogues
9. Jumping will be removed
10. Lowering screen size from 250x140 to 240x135 so the game will look cleaner in full screen
11. Br Portuguese localization (some GUI lines are Deepl translated for now, will be replaced when I get proper translation from the translator)
12. Korean GUI (Korean dialogues are available for a long time)
13. Changeable shoes (you can change to white ones in the school)
14. Fishing mini-game
15. Little tweaks here and there

You can play old versions anytime via beta-branches:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32626098/34a473c82236656146f78abc0edd07e47f65ffdd.png

I tried to make old saves work but I can't guarantee anything sadly, cause some game's logic changed significantly.

A little reminder that I'm a solo dev so expect some bugs ) Please submit them to the forum - I'll try to fix them.

I'll add some new achievements and free roam mode by the end of the next week.

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: New update is coming!
notes.content:
Hello, fellas!

Maybe you know that I'm working on my hobby project about school delinquents now. We almost finished with all background concepts and now I'm working on dialogues, battle mechanics and game structure. It's a lot of work, so I'm not sure when the game will be ready.

As for animations, we took animations from my last game Fading Afternoon, Ueda M. redesigned it for school uniform and my dad added shadows. And since FA used animations from Ringo, now I basically have updated Ringo animations. And some new ones.

I was thinking of making a DLC or even remaster the whole game, but now I decided to just update it for free.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32626098/00c3ec26674000934d21f4a3575624ce8183d569.png

I'm not sure how much content I'll add but my current list is this:

1. Updated sprites for characters
2. New skills for Mechanic (his original skills all sucked)
3. Bicycles
4. New street with bicycle store and fish store
5. Fishing mini-game from FA
6. Local co-op
7. Lowering screen size from 250x140 to 240x135 so the game will look cleaner in full screen (I don't know why I made 250x140... all fonts looks horrible in full screen)
8. Jumping will be removed
9. Updated battle mechanics (I think that battle system could be better, compared to FA and my current project it's not that fun, so I want to update it)
10. Skippable cutscenes and dialogues (as I made it in FA)
11. Some new battle animations (I already made 1 brand new kick that wasn't even in FA, and I want to add some damaging animations from FA and maybe new throw skill for Judo class)
12. Free roam mode
13. Maybe something more...

I think that I'll start updating the game in a couple of weeks, so the first update will be ready by New Year. I won't add all this content in one patch, so it'll be added gradually.

Stay tuned, and thank you very much for your support and continuous interest in the game!

P.S.

Original version will stay available on a different branch.

notes.title: Critical bug in June 29 build
notes.content:
Added a bug this morning when I was fixing Chinese subject names. So the game crashed just after the first Aiko dialogue. 

So anyone who started a new game at June 29 experienced this. Fixed it thanks to Alexis Daniel who emailed me about this one. It was a small typo in the Chinese History subject name and it broke the game. 

Stressed and paranoid. Going for a 4 day vacation. I hope I didn't add any new bugs recently and some of old ones really fixed.

notes.title: Status of localizations
notes.content:
1. Chinese translation has been proofreaded by "Indienova".
2. French translation is nailed by Guillaume Veer.
3. Japanese translation is on the way.
